regime_context: Detector shows a broad, non-directional, two-speed resource-led tape: Gold Miners (score 1.80, breadth 0.93, eligible) lead Silver & Royalties (1.63) and Base Metals (1.31), while defensives (Utilities, Staples, Telecom, REITs) sit deep negative and ineligible. Gate_helps=true so trend discipline is worth respecting, but direction accuracy is historically poor (0.372) — leans are fallible judgement, not detector edge.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Silver & Royalties closes the 0.173 score margin against Gold Miners while keeping breadth above 0.8 — a confirmed handoff (silver score exceeding gold score for 5 consecutive sessions) retires this watch.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Highest score, broadest breadth (0.93), eligible under the absolute-trend gate, and not crowded (z=0.54). This is the leadership leg worth respecting as a trend-following exposure, not a return bet. Crowding not present so no down-size flag.
theses.dissent: Gold leadership is heavily tied to the unscheduled macro surprise share (1.0); if the headline narrative shifts to ai_tech or geopolitics resolves, resource leadership can unwind symmetrically without a crowding signal.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms XBM.TO by 3% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Deep negative score (-0.635), ineligible, weak durability (0.27), very thin breadth (0.083), and negative crowding z (-1.17). Trend gate currently blocks exposure and de-risks defensive equity. Avoid until gate flips eligible.
theses.dissent: A sharp risk-off or rates pivot could reverse defensive underperformance quickly, and mean-revert characteristics in some defensives are not captured by the gate.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO moves back to eligible=true on the absolute-trend gate before the check-by date

theses.subject: Telecom
theses.thesis: Poorest absolute score (-1.04), ineligible, 0% breadth, and strongly negative crowding z (-1.46) — no internal sponsorship. Trend gate correctly excludes it.
theses.dissent: Extreme negative crowding can coincide with wash-out bottoms; if breadth snaps above 0.5 the read changes and the gate would first need to admit eligibility.

falsifier.text: XCD.TO prints 20-day price above its 200-day average with breadth above 0.5 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
